scripts.build: npm run build -w @tomotabi/contracts && npm run build -w @tomotabi/api && npm run build -w @tomotabi/web
scripts.type-check: npm run build -w @tomotabi/contracts && npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.api:check: npm run api:generate && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/shared/api/generated)"
scripts.db:check: npm run db:check -w @tomotabi/api && npm run db:generate -w @tomotabi/api && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/api/drizzle)"
